title: Read Slack channel history with AI before your handover
h1: read a stretch of slack channel history with ai
description: Catch up on a Slack channel for the dates you missed. Get announcements in order, with threads flagged when their replies need a separate read.
keyword: read slack channel history with ai
answer: **come back from holiday knowing what the team announced.** name a slack channel or direct conversation and the dates you missed. a bot reads the main timeline your account can access and brings back a recap. thread replies need their own read, so ask it to flag those. read only access keeps the catch-up from changing slack.

review.by: lead agent, after two independent reviewer passes, against Metal docs and the composio catalog

og_line: the announcements you missed, in order.
what:
**get the week's announcements without scrolling the whole channel.** give the bot a conversation and a date window. it finds the place and narrows the timeline by time.

a parent message shows whether replies exist. a separate thread read gets those replies, including decisions made after the announcement. ask for a timeline recap first and open the flagged threads next.
uses: **catch the announcements you missed on holiday.** keep the summary within those dates.
**rebuild an outage timeline.** pick which threads need a closer read next.
**prepare a handover.** read the recent timeline of a direct conversation you can access.

routine.message: each saturday at 10:45, read the past week's main timeline in harborflint-dispatch on slack. list announced collection times and changed pickup locations here, with posting times. flag messages that have thread replies. don't treat the parent message as final until you read those replies separately. never post, react or edit anything in slack.
routine.needs: slack connected as read only for channel lookup and conversation history
routine.output:
harborflint dispatch timeline
- beatriz announced a friday pickup at the north gate.
- hugh posted a revised collection window. its replies remain unread.
open that thread before treating the window as final.

steps: connect slack as **read only** for this bot.
name the channel or conversation. confirm the account can open it.
give the time window. decide whether to allow a separate thread read too.
try a dated extract. schedule it when the coverage looks right; find later runs in **automations**.
watch: **history leaves thread replies out.** the bot reads those separately.
**busy channels need several batches.** keep reading until the whole week is covered.
**keep going while slack says more history remains.** it can return fewer messages than requested before reaching the end.

faq.q: why did the summary miss a reply inside a thread?
faq.a: **history returns the main timeline only.** the bot needs the separate conversation-replies action for the thread under a message.

faq.q: can it read private channels and direct messages?
faq.a: **yes, where the connected account has access.** those conversation types work. it cannot open conversations outside that account's reach.

steps: name one channel and yesterday's date window
ask for the main announcements and unread threads
open one flagged thread before acting on its parent message

mistakes.mistake: treating the first announcement as the final decision
mistakes.fix: read its replies. the plan might have changed there.

mistakes.mistake: stopping when a batch looks short
mistakes.fix: ask whether slack has more history to return.

tip.text: ask for 'timeline only, unread threads flagged' when you want a quick first pass.

checklist.h: before you act on the recap
items: the bot covered the whole time window
you read the replies behind any final decision
